profile_md:
Nottingham's verified employer-linked group project provision is concentrated in **Nottingham University Business School (NUBS)**, with weaker, partial routes in Computer Science, Engineering and Arts.

**NUBS.** The Company-based Consultancy Challenge (c.3 weeks, extracurricular and selective) pairs teams of six to eight with local partner organisations (2025: IBM among others; 2026: Hallam, ApplyU, Capital One, Notts County Foundation); each organisation gets two teams, with company representatives mentoring and a panel of business partners judging. The 2026 edition was opened from MSc to selected undergraduates. The MSc Entrepreneurship Project (12 groups with 12 start-ups/local companies in 2025, three months) and the MSc Business Project (group project with an industry partner, e.g. Haleon in 2024; 60-credit summer option subject to selection) are curricular. An optional UG Business Project is only partly evidenced.

**Central.** The Careers-run Nottingham Consultancy Challenge (multidisciplinary teams for local business/charity) is not running in 2025/26 and relaunches in 2026/27; Sustainability/EDI challenges and Advantage Award modules do not show employer-set briefs.

**Computing/engineering/arts.** Compulsory group projects exist (Year 2 Software Engineering Group Project, about half with industry partners; Year 3 ECE Group Project with stakeholders 'typically external to the Department'; MEng Group Programming Project for a client that may be a research group; Mechanical Group Design and Make with some industry ideas; Employing the Arts), but external-partner involvement is partial or unclear. The Horizon CDT Sprint Project has an industry-set challenge but covers one PhD cohort.

Provision is distributed, with no institution-wide route. Uncertain: current-year status of most curricular routes and partner share in the Computer Science and Engineering projects.
gaps: Current (2025/26-2026/27) delivery evidence is thin for S2-S11. Further departmental capstones likely exist (Chemical Engineering design projects linked to industry, Product Design group projects, Computer Science/Engineering MSc projects, Pharmacy, Geography, Education, Architecture) and were not verified. Evidence is search-summary paraphrase only (no pages opened). Credit values, enrolment numbers and the partner split for CS Year 2 and ECE group projects not found.
